name: Cosmo Bowl Turkish – Shot
description: The Cosmo Bowl Shot is a high-quality handcrafted hookah bowl from Russia, designed for efficient heat management and enhanced smoking sessions. Made from premium clay and fired at approximately 1100°C, this bowl offers durability, excellent heat retention, and optimal flavor preservation. Key Features: Material: High-quality Russian clay, capable of withstanding high temperatures. Design: Multi-hole (Turkish-style) design promotes intense smoke production and efficient airflow. Tobacco Capacity: Holds around 10-14 grams of tobacco, making it ideal for medium-length smoking sessions. Compatibility: Works with both heat management devices (HMDs) like Kaloud Lotus and traditional foil setups.

name: Black Burn Grape Lollipop – 100gr
description: Grape lollipop This BlackBurn soda will definitely quench any thirst. The grape flavor is quite complex to replicate, so there is often some skepticism about it. However, this soda pleasantly surprises. The aroma is “alive,” as if it were a natural fruit. The taste resembles grape juice – rich, with a slightly tangy note, and there is also a hint of something honey soda-like in the background. It works great when smoked solo. The taste is prominent and generously accompanies the entire smoking process. There is no doubt for a moment that the bowl is filled with a non-cloying, sweet-tangy grape juice. The blend proves to be heat-resistant and, if overheated, it recuperates relatively quickly. It is also stronger in strength than average. Overall, it is juicy and probably one of the longest-lasting flavors.

name: Black Burn Grape Lollipop – 200gr
description: Grape lollipop This BlackBurn soda will definitely quench any thirst. The grape flavor is quite complex to replicate, so there is often some skepticism about it. However, this soda pleasantly surprises. The aroma is “alive,” as if it were a natural fruit. The taste resembles grape juice – rich, with a slightly tangy note, and there is also a hint of something honey soda-like in the background. It works great when smoked solo. The taste is prominent and generously accompanies the entire smoking process. There is no doubt for a moment that the bowl is filled with a non-cloying, sweet-tangy grape juice. The blend proves to be heat-resistant and, if overheated, it recuperates relatively quickly. It is also stronger in strength than average. Overall, it is juicy and probably one of the longest-lasting flavors.

description: HookahJohn UNCUT Robust – Margolis 100g Velvety Peach • Exotic Guava • Earthy Dark Burley A tropical powerhouse built for those who demand depth and strength. HookahJohn UNCUT Robust Margolis takes the fan-favorite blend of sweet, golden peaches and musky exotic guava and injects it into a heavy-duty dark leaf base. The result is a lush, nectar-like inhale that is immediately grounded by the deep, nutty, and slightly cocoa undertones of unwashed Burley tobacco. Unlike its blonde counterpart, the Robust version offers a significant nicotine buzz and a bold throat hit, transforming a bright tropical fruit mix into a sophisticated, multi-layered experience. Expect massive, dense clouds and a lingering, fragrant sweetness that holds its own against the intense character of the dark leaf.

Expect massive, dense clouds and a clean, lingering tingle that keeps the session refreshing from start to finish.

description: Kaloud – “Samsaris Vitria II” Hybrid Bowl FDA-Approved Silicone • Removable Glass Core • Lotus Compatible A pinnacle of heat management and flavor purity. The Kaloud Samsaris Vitria II revolutionizes your session by combining the durability of high-grade, heat-safe silicone with the flawless flavor transfer of a premium glass core. The flexible silicone exterior naturally grips your stem, eliminating the need for a rubber grommet, while remaining safe to touch during your session. Inside, the removable, segmented glass phunnel insert ensures even baking of your shisha, locking in juices and preventing flavor ghosting for incredibly easy cleanup. Engineered with a precision-molded lip, the Vitria II perfectly seats the Kaloud Lotus Heat Management Device, creating a secure seal that maximizes cloud production and dramatically extends the life of your bowl. It is the ultimate upgrade for modern hookah enthusiasts seeking a clean, effortless, and premium smoking experience.

name: Kong Phunnel Lava
description: “KONG PHUNNEL LAVA” is one of the most complex and worthy works from Kong. The bowl represents a mixture of the two most powerful elements: earth and fire. Working on a new form of fanel, we clearly saw that the lava design would be the perfect combination for it. In the new line of fanel, we diversified the Lava palette with unusual bright colors, so you can easily choose a new bowl for any hookah color. An interesting fact: the temperature of real lava lies in the range from 1000 to 1200 degrees. And you smoke a hookah on a bowl that was fired at a temperature of 1200 degrees. Real lava in your hands! Tobacco flow rate: 18-20 gramm Holes in chilim: 5

description: Cuba – the birthplace of tobacco culture. We present to you a unique Cuban blend , crafted in the same way as a premium cigar mix — using cigar leaves: Ligero, Viso, two types of Seco , and a wrapper leaf. description: MISHA HERO Zmeya Dangerous. Stylish. Unforgettable. The MISHA Hero Zmeya is the latest addition to the HERO line, crafted for rebels who refuse to blend in. Like a snake—elegant yet dangerous—this hookah strikes with a venomous design, sharp details, and a bold charisma that draws every eye in the room. Known as a true serpent enthusiast, MISHA brings that passion to life with a finely polished stainless steel overlay featuring a detailed snake motif coiling around the shaft. The result? A fierce and unforgettable visual impact. Every detail is deliberate—new engravings on the tray, decorative polished steel rings that elevate the design, and an aesthetic keychain that completes the image with flair. At its core is the trusted MISHA Revolt base , known for reliability and ease of use. MISHA Hero Zmeya isn’t just a hookah—it’s a statement. Made for those who value bold design, attention to detail, and standing out from the crowd. Trust MISHA—he knows what he’s doing. Be dangerous. Be a hero. And don’t fear snakes—they’re awesome! name: Moze Flare Charcoal Basket
description: Moze – “Flare” Charcoal Basket Premium Metal Construction • Safe Coal Transport • Sleek Modern Design The perfect blend of safety, functionality, and striking design. The Moze Flare Charcoal Basket is an essential, high-quality accessory designed to safely hold and transport glowing hot coconut coals. Crafted from premium, heat-resistant metal, this carrier ensures maximum durability and longevity even under extreme daily temperatures. It features Moze’s signature modern aesthetic with precision-cut “flare” detailing, which allows for optimal airflow while keeping ash securely contained within the deep base. The extended, ergonomic handle keeps your hand safely away from the heat source, making coal management effortless and secure. Whether for a bustling lounge environment or your personal home sessions, the Moze Flare is a stylish, highly practical must-have for maintaining a clean and premium hookah setup.

name: Moze Sphere Two – Blurry Neptune
description: Finally back! The Moze Sphere 2 is the successor of the successful Moze Sphere. Let yourself be enchanted by the unique look and the stunning blow-off. The advantages of the Sphere 2 compared to its predecessor: New Colorways: The Sphere 2 comes in five new colorways. The distinctive Orb makes the Sphere something special. The polished orb is composed of natural wood and epoxy resin. In combination with the glossy finish, the Orb leaves a radiance in the room that you know from no other hookah. Optimized Flow: The Sphere 2 convinces not only with its appearance but also with its performance. The adjusted inner diameter allows for a smooth flow and good tightening behavior, coupled with the simple blow-off system leaving no expectations unfulfilled. New materials: The high-quality coating of the plate and the stainless steel base set the Sphere 2 apart from its predecessor and bring that extra bit of quality. Safety: Fit-optimized seal, as well as rounded spikes, make your smoking experience not only more beautiful but also safer. +LINE : The Sphere 2 also has additional accessories in the +LINE, such as seals or orbs.

name: Steamulation Cooling Control
description: This optionally directs part of the air blown out back into the upper smoke column to the tobacco head. This allows the tobacco head to be cooled in a targeted manner. The air volume is adjustable and can either be switched off or remain permanently activated. The Cooling Control Adapter is simply inserted between the base and the smoke column and can be combined with all X Blow Offs and sleeves. (Note: When the cooling system is used, the discharge pressure increases slightly. This causes the overpressure function to respond earlier. If this is not desired, the overpressure function can be deactivated at the unused smoke connections by closing the AirFlow-Control). Compatibility: Pro X Mini, Pro X Prime (II), Pure (One), Pro X (III), Ultimate (One)

name: Steamulation Cooling Diffusor Carbon Black
description: The Steamulation Cooling Diffuser is another fascinating innovation from Steamulation and takes smoking behavior to a new level. The Steamulation Cooling Diffuser combines numerous functions in its compact design that enhance and optimize shisha enjoyment in a unique way. The functions are diverse: – The tobacco head is cooled by 4 purge valves, the blow-out volume and response behavior are adjustable. – 10-way length-adjustable immersion tube. – Diffuser with 16 air nozzles and self-cleaning effect. – Diffuser valve that prevents the water column from rising in the dip tube. – Integrated molasses catcher, container body made of real carbon. The Steamulation Cooling Diffuser is compatible with all current Steamulation models: Steamulation Superior, Pro X I – III, Prime Pro X I and II, Pure and Pure One, Pro X Mini, Classic, Prime, Xpansion, Ultimate and Ultimate One. Excluded: Steamulation Pro model from 2019

name: WOOKAH MINI – MAUVE w/ Misty Base
description: WOOKAH Mini Body Mauve combines the natural charm of wood with a dash of human creativity through a unique, colorful finish. This WOOKAH piece was created to evoke natural wonders such as summer berries, morganite stones, aster flowers, or an early sundawn over a misty meadow. With its delicate appearance, it brings a fresh and contemporary touch to any interior. WOOKAH Mini includes a quick lock system , a technical solution, which enables quick and convenient mounting of the WOOKAH body to the WOOKAH vase. With just a short movement you can match the two elements. It also has a ground joint connection. The valve adapter has been equipped with an additional grommet, which means you don’t have to worry about the valve or the ball falling out of the adapter. WOOKAH Mini Vase Misty Smooth – the inspiration for the vase itself, as well as for the name, was a hazy morning, delighting with its subtlety and delicacy. The method used to produce this vase is sandblasting, also known as matting, which provides a modern and original effect. The distinctness of the Misty Smooth vase derives from the fact that its surface is completely smooth and lacks cuts. It includes 1.4301 (V2A) stainless steel thread with WOOKAH engraving. Each Smooth Vase is unique and handmade, therefore the weight of each product may vary. This fact does not affect the quality of WOOKAH. Quick lock system – enables quick and convenient mounting of the WOOKAH vase to the WOOKAH body. With just a short movement you can match the two elements.

Funnel’s simplicity is also its great advantage – one lange inlet prevents molasses staining and ensures smooth smoke passage. WOOKAH Funnel Flow is higher and slimmer and its simpler structure makes cleaning and maintenance easier. WOOKAH Funnel Flow is not just a funnel; it is your ticket to sublime hookah experiences. It’s main feature is to make valves and hose connectors match the adapters easily without grommets. The pieces can be securely mounted without using additional seals.
